I’m not able to make the API call directly from here, but I can show you exactly what you’d need to send to VirusTotal’s API so you can run it yourself (or have your own script do it).

**Endpoint**

```
POST https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments
```

**Headers**

| Header | Value |
|--------|-------|
| `x-apikey` | `ABC321` |
| `Content-Type` | `application/json` |

**Body**

```json
{
  "type": "comment",
  "attributes": {
    "text": "Confirmed #malware"
  }
}
```

**Example using `curl`**

```bash
curl -X POST \
     -H "x-apikey: ABC321" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"type":"comment","attributes":{"text":"Confirmed #malware"}}' \
     https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments
```

If you prefer to use a programming language, here’s a quick Python snippet (you’ll need `requests` installed):

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.1.1/comments"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": "ABC321",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
payload = {
    "type": "comment",
    "attributes": {
        "text": "Confirmed #malware"
    }
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
print(response.status_code)
print(response.json())
```

Running either of those will post the comment “Confirmed #malware” to the IP address 192.168.1.1 on VirusTotal. Let me know if you hit any errors or need help interpreting the response!
